Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class DashboardSpec

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.DashboardSpec
public final class DashboardSpec extends Object
A dashboard: a rail of filter sections beside a grid of card panels, with a status header and optional persistence.

Added to a builder page with PageSpec.dashboard(DashboardSpec), which adds the panel and card-section cards to the page and the dashboard toolkit pack. A page has at most one dashboard. Every structural problem is E-77 when the page is built.

Example:

page.dashboard(DashboardSpec.create("orders").title("Orders") .rail(Rail.left().sections( RangeSection.quick("7d", "30d").publishes(Topics.filter("range")))) .grid(2) .panel(daily).panel(byReason).panel("notes", 2) .status(Topics.data("orders")) .persist(PersistSpec.page("app.orders").topics(Topics.filter("range")).shareLink()));

Since:
10.0.0
